lead_instrument_candidate.name: ELBA - Electron Beamline for fundamental science
lead_instrument_candidate.interpretation: ELBA is a strong scientific candidate but its current instrument page does not establish availability in the 9th User Call. Do not select it until the September 15 full offer confirms access.

laser_context.rule: Never substitute commissioning maximums for the guaranteed or call-specific user offer.

proposed_qvos_contribution: Shot-level provenance linking laser, electron-beam, detector, calibration, environmental, and analysis states.
Physics-constrained synthetic diagnostics estimating latent shot parameters with explicit uncertainty rather than replacing primary diagnostics.
Preregistered null tests and controlled parameter transformations for intensity, polarization, timing, and geometry.
Blind synthetic-signal injection to measure false-promotion and recovery behavior before analyzing discovery-sensitive observables.
Competing instrument, classical-background, standard-QED, vacuum-polarization, and optional BSM residual models with increasing evidence burden.
Deterministic analysis replay and evidence custody suitable for independent reanalysis.
call9_launch_checklist: Confirm whether ELBA is explicitly offered in Call 9.
Record exact Call-9 guaranteed laser/electron-beam parameters instead of carrying older portal values forward.
Confirm allowable user diagnostics, vacuum cleanliness, trigger/timing interfaces, physical envelope, power/data interfaces, and safety constraints.
Confirm what raw and processed shot metadata can be made available to a user diagnostics/assurance layer.
Confirm whether a methodological strong-field-QED assurance proposal is scientifically appropriate for the instrument and experimental period.
Contact the listed instrument scientist before submission only after the full offer establishes the relevant configuration.
Register/recover an ELI user account and verify UOS access.
Re-score all Call-9 instruments rather than forcing ELBA if another offered configuration provides a better falsifiable experiment.
Freeze publication/IP strategy before disclosing proprietary Worldshepherd implementation details.

instrument_selection_scorecard.note: Internal score is a prioritization tool, not beamtime acceptance probability.

evidence_promotion_gates: E1 software/replay validation on synthetic strong-field data
E2 independent domain-expert review and facility-interface feasibility
E3 accepted facility proposal or equivalent authorized experiment plan
E4 instrument-integrated calibration and null tests
E5 physical experiment with complete uncertainty and provenance
E6 independent replication for extraordinary or beyond-Standard-Model claims
claims_boundary: The 9th ELI User Call full offer is not yet published as of September 7, 2026; launch is September 15.
ELBA scientific relevance does not establish Call-9 availability.
No ELI User Registry account, UOS access, instrument-scientist engagement, proposal submission, or beamtime award is established in connected records.
The August 2026 HAPLS 0.95-PW commissioning milestone is not represented as a guaranteed ELBA or Call-9 user parameter.
Worldshepherd does not claim physical strong-field-QED validation, quantum-vacuum detection, new physics, or facility integration.
Any BSM result remains a residual-search hypothesis requiring exclusion of instrument, background, and standard-QED explanations plus independent replication.
